sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: PH-100 – two-year supply agreement
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

We value our twelve-year partnership and want an agreement that supports both reliable supply and a healthy foundry. In exchange for a 24-month commitment at 4,000 housings per year, please consider these alternatives:

A: EUR 49.00 per housing, payment 60 days net, contract 24 months, new price effective 1 April 2027.
B: EUR 49.20 per housing, payment 30 days net, contract 24 months, new price effective 1 April 2027.
C: EUR 50.00 per housing, payment 45 days net, contract 24 months, new price effective 1 February 2027.

Lead time remains 35 days and delivery FCA. Please tell us which structure best supports your production and cash flow. Could you also share your full cost per housing, including overhead, and the energy and wage changes behind the increase? We want to distinguish necessary cost recovery from the benefit of longer planning security.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 February 2027.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We value our twelve-year partnership and welcome the 24-month commitment, though as a matter of principle we do not disclose our internal cost structures.
Please provide the data supporting your projection of 4,000 housings per year so we can properly evaluate the volume benefit.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €51.50 per unit.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: PH-100 – volume commitment and revised packages
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for the substantial move and for supporting the two-year agreement. Our purchasing requirement is 4,000 housings per year for the next two years; we can commit that volume under the 24-month agreement. This is our requirement, not a claim of increased volume versus past orders.

We respect your decision not to disclose internal costs. We have increased our proposed prices and offer these alternatives, each for 24 months:
A: EUR 49.50 per housing, 60 days net, effective 1 April 2027.
B: EUR 49.50 per housing, 30 days net, effective 1 April 2027.
C: EUR 50.30 per housing, 45 days net, effective 1 February 2027.
Lead time remains 35 days, FCA.

The 30-day option gives you earlier cash, while the committed volume provides planning security. If none is workable, please identify the combination and minimum price that would preserve a sustainable operating margin without sharing your detailed cost structure.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.subject: PH-100 – payment and implementation alternatives
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for confirming that your revised price supports reliable supply. We cannot commit more than 4,000 housings annually; the 24-month commitment remains firm. Rather than promise volume we do not need, we would like to explore payment and implementation terms.

Please consider these revised alternatives, each for a 24-month contract with the new price effective 1 April 2027:
A: EUR 49.90 per housing, payment 60 days net.
B: EUR 50.00 per housing, payment 30 days net.
C: EUR 50.60 per housing, payment 30 days net.

Option C is a further price concession in exchange for the April implementation date. Lead time remains 35 days and delivery FCA. Please confirm your best workable package on that basis; we want to settle the agreement without compromising dependable production.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our family foundry has always valued the long standing relationship between our two companies, and we deeply appreciate your flexibility regarding the implementation date and the 30-day payment terms. Building on your third option, we can offer a price of €50.90 per unit with 30 days payment and the 1 April 2027 effective date. 

To summarize our Angebot, we are proposing a price of €50.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer is valid for 30 days.

This is a significant step from our side to reach an agreement that works for both of our houses, reflecting our commitment to our shared future and continued partnership.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: PH-100 – closing the remaining gap
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for agreeing to the April implementation date. We are close to an agreement and appreciate your movement. To close the remaining gap, we can increase our 30-day proposal and also offer higher prices against longer payment terms:

A: EUR 50.65 per housing, payment 30 days net.
B: EUR 50.75 per housing, payment 45 days net.
C: EUR 50.90 per housing, payment 60 days net.

All three alternatives are for 24 months, with the new price effective 1 April 2027, 4,000 housings per year, 35-day lead time and FCA delivery. Please confirm the package you can support as your firm offer so we can conclude the agreement.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We appreciate your continued efforts to close the gap, but we cannot reduce the price further for the 30-day payment term. We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

Over the years, our partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH has been built on quality, trust, and mutual respect. For our family-run foundry and its dedicated people, it remains vital to deliver the reliability you expect from us while maintaining a solid foundation for our shared future in the region. 

We therefore maintain our offer of a price of €50.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. This represents a fair and sustainable agreement for both our houses over the next two years. 

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: PH-100 – price premium for 60-day payment
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

We respect your position on the EUR 50.90 price with 30-day payment and are not asking you to reduce that price further.

Instead, we can offer EUR 51.20 per housing in exchange for payment at 60 days net. The contract remains 24 months, with the new price effective 1 April 2027, a commitment of 4,000 housings annually, 35-day lead time and FCA delivery.

This increases the price by EUR 0.30 over your current offer to support the change in payment terms. Please confirm this complete package as your firm offer if workable.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

For your records, our current offer is a price of €51.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer stays valid for 30 days. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.
